title: Network throughput and storage latency KPIs

spec.title: Network throughput and storage latency KPIs
spec.lead: Sub-millisecond disk write latency and dedicated inter-region bandwidth prevent replication queue buildup.

items.label: Target: local log write latency
items.text: Storage: Persistent Disk Extreme (pd-extreme) for SQL Server transaction logs · Purpose: prevents synchronous commit delays between Zone A and Zone B.

items.label: Target: minimum inter-region bandwidth
items.text: Network: Google Cloud VPC cross-region egress allocation · Purpose: sustains continuous asynchronous log shipping to Region 2 during peak clinical batch loads.

items.label: Target: cross-region round-trip time
items.text: Topology: Region 1 to Region 2 VPC peering link · Purpose: keeps asynchronous send queues drained and within the cross-region RPO threshold.

spec.takeaway: Sizing rule: provision pd-extreme log disks and 10 Gbps egress headroom so storage and network layers never bottleneck Always On commit acknowledgement.
spec.notes:
To maintain sub-minute intra-region RTO and near-zero RPO across zones, the underlying Persistent Disk storage and VPC network between Region 1 and Region 2 must prevent log send and redo queue bottlenecks. We set strict engineering targets of under 1ms local disk write latency, 10 Gbps inter-region bandwidth, under 15ms cross-region RTT, and zero packet drop tolerance.

Sources:
